game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the mushroom ring.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the mushroom ring. Each round, mischievous sprites strike the mushroom ring, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mushroom ring from mischievous sprites in Lantern Path: keep the pattern_rows meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: pattern_rows drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Lantern Path'. Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Lantern Path.
